entities.summary: The Ashgabat cinema is a movie theater in Ashgabat. The theater is on Magtymguly Avenue near the Kopetdag Stadium. Opened on June 29, 2011, it is the first 3D cinema in Turkmenistan. Ashgabat Cinema is a movie theater in Asia, established in 2011-06-29. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
